gloss: to concentrate; to focus; to converge
notes:
One of the most common and useful suru verbs. Has two main uses: (1) focusing one's attention or effort, and (2) the convergence or concentration of things in one place or time. Takes the particle に to mark what one is concentrating on.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}{力|りょく}: concentration, ability to focus
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}{治療|ちりょう}{室|しつ}: intensive care unit (ICU)
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}{豪雨|ごうう}: localized heavy rain
- {集中|しゅうちゅう}{攻撃|こうげき}: concentrated attack
- {一極|いっきょく}{集中|しゅうちゅう}: concentration in one center (often describing Tokyo)

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- ～に{集中|しゅうちゅう}する: to concentrate on ~
- ～が{集中|しゅうちゅう}する: ~ converges/concentrates

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {専念|せんねん}する: to devote oneself to — implies giving up other things to focus exclusively
- {注力|ちゅうりょく}する: to focus efforts on — more business-oriented; emphasizes directing resources
- {没頭|ぼっとう}する: to be absorbed in — implies being deeply engrossed, losing track of everything else

definitions.gloss: to direct one's attention or mental effort on a single task or subject
definitions.explanation: to direct one's attention or mental effort on a single task or subject; to focus one's mind

definitions.gloss: to gather or converge in one place or on one point
definitions.explanation: to gather or converge in one place or on one point; for things to be concentrated or centralized

examples.japanese: {勉強|べんきょう}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}する。
{静|しず}かな{場所|ばしょ}でないと{集中|しゅうちゅう}できない。
examples.english: I can't concentrate unless it's a quiet place.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}{前|まえ}は{苦手|にがて}な{科目|かもく}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}して{取|と}り{組|く}んだ。
examples.english: Before the exam, I concentrated on working on my weak subjects.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}が{都市|とし}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}している。
examples.english: The population is concentrated in the cities.

examples.japanese: {注文|ちゅうもん}が{一|いち}{時期|じき}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}した。
examples.english: Orders were concentrated in one period.

examples.japanese: {批判|ひはん}が{一人|ひとり}の{政治家|せいじか}に{集中|しゅうちゅう}している。
examples.english: Criticism is focused on a single politician.
